question: Which Indian Chess player was in attendance along with other officials to receive the official hosting rights of FIDE 44th World Chess Olympiad 2022 on behalf of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Viswanathan Anand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Viswanathan Anand is a former World Chess Champion and one of the most prominent figures in Indian chess.
 
• He has won the World Chess Championship five times, making him one of the greatest chess players of all time.
 
• Anand was the first Indian to achieve the title of Grandmaster in 1988.
 
• He has received numerous awards, including the Padma Vibhushan, India's second-highest civilian award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **FIDE (Fédération Internationale des Échecs or International Chess Federation)**

 
 
• FIDE is the global organization responsible for overseeing international chess competitions and regulations.
 
• Founded in 1924, it is recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) as the governing body of chess.
 
• FIDE organizes the World Chess Championship and other major chess tournaments.
 
• It also maintains the official world chess ratings and titles, such as Grandmaster (GM), International Master (IM), and others.
 
 
 
• **World Chess Olympiad**
 
 
• The World Chess Olympiad is a biennial chess tournament organized by FIDE.
 
• It is one of the most prestigious team competitions in chess, featuring teams from countries all over the world.
 
• The first official Olympiad was held in 1927 in London.
 
• The Olympiad consists of both open and women's tournaments, with teams competing in a round-robin or Swiss-system format.
 
 
 
• **Koneru Humpy**
 
 
• Koneru Humpy is an Indian chess player who achieved the title of Grandmaster in 2002.
 
• She is one of the top female chess players in the world and has won numerous national and international titles.
 
• Humpy has also been a strong representative for India in various Chess Olympiads and other team events.
 
 
 
• **Dibyendu Barua and Abhijit Kunte**
 
 
• Dibyendu Barua is an Indian Grandmaster who became the second Indian to achieve this title after Viswanathan Anand.
 
• Abhijit Kunte is also an Indian Grandmaster who has represented India in multiple Chess Olympiads.
